name: apfixed_w8a8
purpose: Verify w8a8 actual AMD ap_fixed arithmetic against numpy on butterfly even though the 13-image quality scan fails the 0.1 dB gate by 5.18 dB.
changes: Independent fixed reference retains golden external float signature; internal weights/biases and activations use AP_RND_CONV/AP_SAT. Exact product-fraction accumulators.
interpretation: Passing arithmetic identity is distinct from passing image quality. The complete all-ap_fixed butterfly output must match numpy; the 13-image scan remains the precision evidence and w8a8 is ineligible for whole-network selection.
conclusion: Save actual ap_fixed butterfly output for subsequent architecture bit-exact checks.
